notes: Today src/cli.mjs only prints the usage line and exits 2, and src/store.mjs does not exist. T1 creates src/store.mjs and gives src/cli.mjs its shape: the command switch, the usage error (exit 2) for anything but `add` and `list` (`list` stays a usage error until T3), and one try/catch around the commands that prints a thrown error's message to stderr and sets process.exitCode = 1. Exit discipline for every path: the CLI never calls process.exit; a usage error sets process.exitCode = 2, an error 1, and success leaves it 0, then the function returns and Node exits when stdout has drained, so piped output is never cut off (T1 replaces the pre-state's process.exit(2)). T2 and T3 add their branches to that shape; T3 depends on T2 only to fix the build order, since both edit the same two files. No dependency is added; package.json stays without one.

Storage (D2, spec A1): data/items.jsonl holds one JSON object per line, {"name":"<name>"} followed by "
", written with appendFileSync. src/store.mjs owns the file: saveItem(name) appends exactly JSON.stringify({name}) + "
" with appendFileSync and nothing else (no read of the file, no guard for a damaged file: recovery is a spec non-goal); listItems() reads the file, splits on "
", drops every empty line wherever it is, parses each remaining line and returns the names in file order, or [] when the file is missing or empty. `list` writes each name followed by "
" through process.stdout.write and writes nothing at all for an empty list. The path is process.env.ITEMS_FILE when that is set and non-empty (used as given, resolved against the working directory), else the module-relative default new URL("../data/items.jsonl", import.meta.url), so add and list use the same file whatever the working directory; the checks set ITEMS_FILE=data/check-items.jsonl (spec A4). data/ is kept in the repo by data/.gitkeep and data/items.jsonl is gitignored.

Names and errors: `add` takes the arguments after `add` joined by one space (`add buy milk` and `add "buy milk"` both save `buy milk`), then trims surrounding whitespace; T1 builds that joining and trimming, the command switch and the try/catch, and T1 saves whatever name it gets. T2 adds exactly one thing, the blank rule inside saveItem: under spec A2 the trimmed name is blank when nothing remains or when a line feed (U+000A) or a carriage return (U+000D) remains inside it (no other character counts); saveItem then throws new Error("item name must not be blank") before writing. A missing argument is the empty string, so it is blank. The try/catch from T1 prints the message to stderr and exits 1.

Risks: a crash mid-append may leave a torn last line, and two processes appending at once may interleave lines; the spec assumes one process at a time (A3) and makes recovering a damaged file a non-goal, so nothing is built for either case: list fails on the damaged line with its JSON error (exit 1) rather than print a partial item, and no task adds a guard or a repair. Durability is likewise a non-goal: saveItem returns when appendFileSync returns, the CLI prints `saved` only after that return, and no fsync is added. Each check sets ITEMS_FILE=data/check-items.jsonl on every command, deletes that file in its first case and shares it across its later cases; a person's data/items.jsonl is never touched by a check (spec A4). A missing data/ folder would fail the append; data/.gitkeep keeps it in the repo.

Checks: item-add (AC1), item-blank (AC2: spaces only, no argument, a line feed inside the name, a carriage return inside the name) and item-list (AC3) each run every command with ITEMS_FILE=data/check-items.jsonl, start by removing that file in their first case and run every command as its own process, so each check starts from nothing and list reads from disk in a new process.

tasks.title: Save an item
tasks.goal: `add <name>` persists the named item and prints `saved`
tasks.exitCondition: item-add passes: `add exercise` exits 0, prints `saved`, and data/items.jsonl holds that one item

tasks.title: Reject a blank name
tasks.goal: `add` with a blank name reports the error on stderr, exits 1 and persists nothing
tasks.exitCondition: item-blank passes and item-add still passes

tasks.title: List saved items
tasks.goal: `list` prints every saved item, one per line, in the order saved
tasks.exitCondition: item-list passes, and item-add and item-blank still pass
